fire: Through the telescope we finally saw the Orion Nebula (M42) glowing faintly.
Microtubules form part of the cytoskeleton in every animal cell.
The galaxy is also catalogued as PGC 12345 in older surveys.
Bright flashes known as gamma-ray bursts were detected last spring.
The Andromeda Galaxy (M31) is the nearest large spiral to us.
Actin filaments help the cell change shape and move.
The Ring Nebula (M57) sits in the constellation Lyra.
Cell motility depends on actin polymerisation at the leading edge.
quiet: Through the window we finally saw the harbour lights glowing faintly.
Wooden beams form part of the frame in every old barn.
The painting is also listed as item 12345 in older catalogues.
Bright flashes of lightning were seen over the hills last spring.
The Andromeda bakery is the nearest good bread shop to us.
Strong ropes help the sailors change the sail and move.
The Ring Road sits on the northern edge of the city.
Team morale depends on good leadership at the top.
